design_axis: APP VISUAL real persistence/recovery infrastructure-status flow
bounded_question: Can healthy persistence remain absent from ordinary deep Character work while a truthful infrastructure exception can interrupt, remain unresolved after explanation closes, and return exactly after externally resolved recovery without fictionalization or a frozen recovery implementation?

close_reconciliation.effect: No contradiction at construction close; both lanes add no persistence/recovery Product semantics that supersede the accepted Design law.

controlled_inputs: Light F2 / Dark D3 / MAT F1 / TYP F1 / STA F2 / FICON F1
accepted persistence/recovery functional and Phase-3 evidence

local_result.summary: Ordinary Julian deep Character inspection is visually free of persistence status when healthy; an injected infrastructure exception names the retained task without fictionalization, Close leaves unresolved status unresolved, and externally simulated recovery returns to quiet task/focus.

mechanical: seven-case healthy + exception + unresolved + recovered matrix PASS
visual: wide/narrow healthy Light/Dark deep Character task with zero persistence status/explanatory copy
wide/narrow exception Light/Dark pair with dashed infrastructure witness
wide unresolved state proving Close did not recover or repair
identical semantic treatment across Light/Dark and forced colors
interaction: Close explanation restores retained task focus while unresolved status remains visible
test-only external recovered state removes status and restores exact retained task focus
no user-facing recovery/save/retry/repair command is introduced

constrains: Future persistence/recovery carriers preserve healthy quiet state, infrastructure-versus-fiction separation, failure-versus-integrity distinction, Close != recovery and exact safe task/focus return unless a named successor supersedes them.

explicit_non_authority: No retry/repair/conflict/fallback/data-loss/recovery algorithm, read-only policy or integrity validation.
No Scene/Take/branch/rehearsal/consequence semantics or severity/status color system.
No Stage successor, production tokens, native implementation, shipping or Store authority.

director_review_surface.what_to_review: healthy quiet state, truthful infrastructure exception, unresolved-after-Close state, failure-versus-integrity separation and exact recovered task/focus return
